[IDAT.3.3.8] **Dual ownership shape.** `ds_json_t` is the one type
that is both integrator-owned and library-owned depending on
provenance. A tree the integrator built (`ds_json_parse` /
`ds_json_new_*`) is integrator-owned and integrator-freed. A tree
delivered to a record / cache callback as a `const ds_json_t *`
payload is a library-owned borrow, valid only for the callback's
duration ([IDAT.10.3]). A tree read from a fact's `Json` slot
with `ds_fact_get_slot` is a library-owned borrow too, valid until
that fact is retracted ([NFCT.6.2]). The engine's deep-clone-on-assert
([NFCT.2.4]) is what keeps the two disjoint — a built tree handed
to the engine and the engine's stored copy are independent trees,
each freed by its own owner.
